The '''Bat Artifact''' is a {{Legendary}} [[Accessory]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Shop Purchase ===
The '''Bat Artifact''' can be purchased from the {{NPCSprite|Fear Mongerer}} during the [[Spooky Festival]] for {{Item|Purple Candy|amount=64}} and {{Item|Bat Ring|amount=1}}.
